objects.name: Analytic 2143
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies passwd/chpasswd modification of Industrial Control System (ICS) service account credentials by a User Identifier (UID) that is not a designated system administrator, outside a formal credential rotation procedure. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: auditd:SYSCALL
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL/EXECVE/SOCKADDR records (configured audit rule): syscall=execve; passwd/chpasswd targets an ICS service account outside the approved credential-rotation workflow

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Accounts authorized to change credentials for ICS service and operator accounts.
Time window after a credential change within which a service authentication failure is considered directly connected.
Documented schedule for routine credential rotation.
